interface.longDescription: Generate images and video without leaving the chat. APIPod connects ChatGPT and Codex to the leading image models (Nano Banana, Seedream, FLUX, GPT Image) and video models (Seedance, Kling, Gemini Omni, Wan, MiniMax) through one account. Ask in plain language, review the quote, and get permanent URLs back. Every generation is priced before it runs and refunded automatically if it fails.
